snippet.title: Elderfalls – Gameplay (Open Beta, 27 Nov 2026)
snippet.description:
Real in-game footage of Elderfalls, a free-to-play fantasy MMORPG for Windows and Mac.
Open Beta starts worldwide on Friday, 27 November 2026, 19:00 CET.
